in_tree.note: Adopt the TOPOLOGY, redrawn on sg13_lv_* (this block is on the 1.2 V rail since spec/decisions/0007-rail-1p2v-thin-oxide.md; the sibling's cells are sg13_hv_*), so no byte-identical copy will exist: when the redrawn cell lands this entry becomes `kept` with a record naming the sibling commit as the source of the topology. Condition: re-simulated with 1 GHz inputs across the corner set before use; a failure is a new decision record, not a silent patch.

redrawn.differs: edgedet chain shortened 5 -> 3 stages (device-level 0.16u inverters, odd count kept) and srlatch_fast redrawn with device-level 4u NAND2 gates (inline 4u sg13_lv devices, not nand2x_lv cells), a 2x S-inverter (XIS inv2x_lv) and a 4x R-input inverter (XIR upsized inv2x_lv -> inv4x_lv) (issue #136); the reset path itself is unchanged on the PFD-local 2x/4x cells (XNR nand2x_lv, XR1 inv4x_lv); sibling: NAND + two; see spec/decisions/0008-false-lock-argument.md
redrawn.fit_gate: runs 2026-11-05 (sim/pfd-fit/results/20261105T125120Z), 2026-11-15 run 2 (20261115T001809Z, issue #113) and 2026-11-15 chain-3 + sized latch (20261115T124912Z, issue #136): C1/C3 pass at all corners at both frequencies in all three (ratios 1.00..1.05 in the 2026-11-15 chain-3 run); C2 passes at tt (229..233 ps), ff (154..157 ps) and all 500 MHz corners in the chain-3 run, still fails at ss/1 GHz (362..370 ps against 250). The 31 ps C1/C2 window the chain opens at ss (reset arrival in [+288.7, +319.7] ps) is unreachable for the reset path: the committed as-built measurement is path = 167.2 ps against the 55.1 ps window ceiling (results/20261115T125504Z, a 3x gap), the committed latch release floor is 194.9 ps (same probe), and exploratory reset-path sizing probes across XNR 2u..6u x XR1 4u..8u observed a best of ~149 ps but their records were not retained - recorded as trends, not reproducible evidence (see the 2026-11-15 section of 0011). A 2026-11-15 three-gate RN-latch variant (20261115T003632Z) reached C2's width target but fails C1 and is recorded as evidence only. The two-knob refutation rests on the committed as-built figures; status stays adopting, see the 2026-11-15 (issue #136) section of spec/decisions/0011-pfd-reset-path-too-slow-at-1ghz.md and operator decision #140

in_tree.note: Adopt the topology (cascoded current-steering, cp_leg_n/cp_leg_p, dump buffer), redrawn on sg13_lv_* per 0007; bias currents are re-derived for the DLL's first-order loop. Same path to `kept` as pfd.

redrawn.differs: dump buffer replaced by a unity-gain buffer (NMOS-input and PMOS-input 5-transistor OTAs on one output, biased from IBN and IBP) with MOS decoupling on VDUMP; bias from the new cp_bias cell (MR 2.2u/4u); simulated 5.1..18.6 uA at tt/ss/ff (not 20 uA)
redrawn.fit_gate: run 2026-11-06 (sim/cp-currents/results/20261106T182524Z): K1-K6 pass at tt, ss and ff after the cp_bias/cp_dumpbuf redraw and a stimulus fix (decision 0012, 2026-11-06 section); the 2026-11-05 run (20261105T130112Z) failed K1 and K5. Status stays adopting: charge per pulse is not graded and 0006 gives pfd and cp the same path to kept, while the pfd fit gate is still open (decision 0011)

in_tree.note: The PLL's second-order filter does not fit a first-order DLL loop; a single capacitor is DLL-specific.

not_adopted.decision: kept thin; revisit klt_corner_bundle.py when #2's corner set needs HBT and resistor sections
